en.headline:
Ideas into products.
Design into decisions.
en.intro: I'm Bruce, an AI product manager and builder who brings together product strategy, interaction design, and hands-on prototyping.
en.bio: I study Human–AI Interaction at Harvard GSD, after training in Industrial Design at RISD. I care about the space between what AI can do and what people actually need—and I enjoy turning that gap into products people can use.

experience.summary: Helped take Qwen Create from concept to international launch: an agent-powered creative workspace for marketing content.
details: Defined a workflow with one coordinating agent, five specialists, and reusable tools for research, planning, and image, text, and video creation.
Built evaluation criteria across model quality, planning, execution, and end-to-end task success; worked with engineering, model, design, and go-to-market teams on launch in five markets.

experience.summary: Made subjective UGC quality more measurable by introducing human authenticity as an AI evaluation dimension.
details: Developed prompts, test sets, and failure analysis with algorithm teams, improving evaluator precision/recall from 0.77/0.74 to 0.93/0.91.
Integrated evaluation into production quality and recommendation workflows; related vertical DAU rose 8% and content-quality scores 20%.

experience.summary: Founded a campus sharing platform combining smart lockers, real-time device sync, and a borrowing experience for students.
details: Led user research, hardware–software integration, and the scan → borrow → return → rewards experience.
Launched five stations with 200+ transactions and 78% repeat usage in month one; received $10K from Brown B-Lab and two innovation awards.

capabilities.items: Strategy, user research, experimentation, metrics, market sizing, pricing, go-to-market

capabilities.items: Python, SQL, JavaScript, Figma, Git, Arduino, rapid prototyping

zh.headline:
从想法到产品。
从设计到决策。
zh.intro: 我是 Bruce，一名结合产品策略、交互设计与动手开发的 AI 产品经理与创造者。
zh.bio: 我在哈佛 GSD 攻读设计研究硕士，重点关注 AI 人机交互；本科毕业于 RISD 工业设计专业。我关心的不仅是 AI 能做到什么，更是人们真正需要什么，以及如何把两者连接成好用的产品。

experience.summary: 参与 Qwen Create 从 0 到 1 的产品设计与海外上线，面向营销创作者构建 Agent 驱动的创作工作台。
details: 设计由 1 个主 Agent、5 个专业 Agent 和可复用工具组成的工作流，覆盖调研、策划和图文视频创作。
从模型质量、规划、执行和端到端成功率四个层面建立评测框架，协同研发、模型、设计和市场团队推动产品在五个海外市场上线。

experience.summary: 将 UGC 内容的“真人感”转化为可以评测、迭代并用于推荐决策的 AI 质量标准。
details: 与算法团队设计 Prompt、测试集和失效分析，将评估模型的准确率／召回率从 0.77/0.74 提升至 0.93/0.91。
推动评估能力进入线上内容质量与推荐流程，相关垂类 DAU 提升 8%，内容质量评分提升 20%。

experience.summary: 创立结合智能柜、设备状态实时同步和移动端体验的校园共享平台，帮助学生借用低频物品。
details: 负责用户研究、软硬件整合，以及“扫码 → 借用 → 归还 → 积分”的完整体验。
在高校落地 5 个站点，首月交易 200+ 次、复借率 78%；获 Brown B-Lab 1 万美元支持及两项创新奖。
